title: HSK 3.3 · 当然, 突然, 保护, 坚持, 感受
focus: 受 · 使 · 连 · 当然 · 部 · 消息 · 成功 · 结束 · 者 · 转 · 调查 · 方式 · 保护 · 支持 · 保证 · 突然 · 保持 · 明显 · 绝对 · 坚持 · 证明 · 记者 · 造成 · 支 · 自然 · 面对 · 结婚 · 部门 · 仍然 · 显示 · 仍 · 相当 · 对方 · 正式 · 感情 · 感受 · 后面 · 记录 · 显然 · 外面
body:
Five 然 "so, -ly" adverbs (当然, 突然, 自然, 仍然, 显然), a 保 "keep safe" family and a 持 "hold" family make up most of this lesson.

## Characters that repeat

| Character | Pinyin | Meaning | In this lesson |
|---|---|---|---|
| 然 | rán | so, like this; -ly | 当然, 突然, 自然, 仍然, 显然 |
| 保 | bǎo | keep safe, ensure | 保护, 保证, 保持 |
| 持 | chí | hold (扌 hand + 寺 sì sound) | 支持, 保持, 坚持 |
| 显 | xiǎn | visible, show | 明显, 显示, 显然 |
| 对 | duì | facing, opposite; correct | 绝对, 面对, 对方 |
| 面 | miàn | face, side | 面对, 后面, 外面 |
| 感 | gǎn | feel | 感情, 感受 |
| 记 | jì | note down, remember | 记者, 记录 |

## Watch out

- 仍 réng (still, 亻 person) vs 扔 rēng (throw, 扌 hand).
- 转 is zhuǎn "turn, transfer" (转车) and zhuàn "spin, go round" (转圈).
- 调 is diào in 调查 but tiáo in 空调.

cards.Example: 我受不了了！ wǒ shòu bu liǎo le: I can't take it anymore!
cards.Notes: 爫 hand on top + 冖 + 又 hand below = passing something hand to hand → receive. Compare 爱 ài, which has 友 at the bottom.

cards.Example: 这使我很高兴。 zhè shǐ wǒ hěn gāoxìng: this makes me happy
cards.Notes: 亻 person + 吏 lì official = a person sent on an errand → to send, use, cause. Lookalike: 便 biàn.

cards.Meaning: even (连…都); to link; in a row
cards.Example: 他连饭都没吃。 tā lián fàn dōu méi chī: he didn't even eat
cards.Notes: 辶 walk + 车 cart = carts moving in a line → link. 连…都/也 = even.

cards.Example: 当然可以！ dāngrán kěyǐ: of course you can!
cards.Notes: 当 should, as it ought + 然 so = as it ought to be → of course.

cards.Example: 这部电影很好看。 zhè bù diànyǐng hěn hǎokàn: this film is great
cards.Notes: 咅 pǒu (sound) + 阝 on the right (city, region) = a district → part, department.

cards.Example: 有好消息吗？ yǒu hǎo xiāoxi ma: any good news?
cards.Notes: 消 fade away + 息 grow, breathe; old sense "waning and waxing" → news of how things go.

cards.Example: 祝你成功！ zhù nǐ chénggōng: wishing you success!
cards.Notes: 成 accomplish + 功 achievement (工 work + 力 effort) = accomplish the work → succeed.

cards.Example: 会议结束了。 huìyì jiéshù le: the meeting is over
cards.Notes: 结 tie a knot + 束 bind (a bundle of 木 tied up) = tie it off → end.

cards.Example: 记者来了。 jìzhě lái le: the reporters have come
cards.Notes: Suffix like English -er: 记者 reporter, 作者 author. Also the sound part of 都, 著, 猪.

cards.Meaning: to turn, transfer / to spin, go round
cards.Example: 前面左转。 qiánmiàn zuǒ zhuǎn: turn left up ahead
cards.Notes: 车 vehicle + 专 zhuān for the sound = a wheel turning → turn.

cards.Example: 警察在调查。 jǐngchá zài diàochá: the police are investigating
cards.Notes: 调 diào look into, transfer + 查 check = investigate. 调 is tiáo in 空调.

cards.Example: 这是最好的方式。 zhè shì zuì hǎo de fāngshì: this is the best way
cards.Notes: 方 method, direction + 式 style, pattern = way of doing things.

cards.Example: 我们要保护环境。 wǒmen yào bǎohù huánjìng: we should protect the environment
cards.Notes: 保 keep safe + 护 guard (扌 hand + 户 hù for the sound) = protect.

cards.Example: 我支持你。 wǒ zhīchí nǐ: I support you
cards.Notes: 支 prop up + 持 hold (扌 hand + 寺 sì for the sound) = prop up and hold → support.

cards.Example: 我保证不迟到。 wǒ bǎozhèng bù chídào: I promise not to be late
cards.Notes: 保 ensure + 证 proof (讠 speech + 正 zhèng for the sound) = vouch with proof → guarantee.

cards.Example: 突然下雨了。 tūrán xià yǔ le: it suddenly started raining
cards.Notes: 突 burst out (穴 hole + 犬 dog: a dog darting from its hole) + 然 -ly = suddenly.

cards.Example: 保持安静。 bǎochí ānjìng: keep quiet
cards.Notes: 保 keep + 持 hold = keep holding → maintain.

cards.Example: 这很明显。 zhè hěn míngxiǎn: that's obvious
cards.Notes: 明 bright + 显 visible (日 sun + 业) = brightly visible → obvious.

cards.Example: 我绝对同意。 wǒ juéduì tóngyì: I absolutely agree
cards.Notes: 绝 cut off, utmost (纟 + 色) + 对 opposite, correct = with no opposite → absolute.

cards.Example: 坚持下去！ jiānchí xiàqu: keep going!
cards.Notes: 坚 firm, hard (土 earth at the bottom) + 持 hold = hold firmly → persist.

cards.Example: 你能证明吗？ nǐ néng zhèngmíng ma: can you prove it?
cards.Notes: 证 evidence + 明 clear = make clear with evidence → prove.

cards.Example: 她是记者。 tā shì jìzhě: she's a journalist
cards.Notes: 记 record + 者 one who = one who records → reporter.

cards.Example: 这造成了很多问题。 zhè zàochéng le hěn duō wèntí: this caused a lot of problems
cards.Notes: 造 make (辶 + 告 gào for the sound) + 成 become = bring about → cause.

cards.Meaning: (classifier: pens, songs, teams); to prop up
cards.Example: 给我一支笔。 gěi wǒ yì zhī bǐ: give me a pen
cards.Notes: 十 + 又 hand = a hand holding a branch → branch, prop; classifier for stick-like things.

cards.Example: 这很自然。 zhè hěn zìrán: that's natural
cards.Notes: 自 self + 然 so = so by itself → natural.

cards.Example: 我们要面对问题。 wǒmen yào miànduì wèntí: we have to face the problem
cards.Notes: 面 face + 对 facing = face to face → confront.

cards.Example: 他们结婚了。 tāmen jiéhūn le: they got married
cards.Notes: 结 tie + 婚 marriage (女 woman + 昏 hūn for the sound) = tie the marriage knot.

cards.Example: 你在哪个部门？ nǐ zài nǎge bùmén: which department are you in?
cards.Notes: 部 section + 门 door, branch = department.

cards.Example: 他仍然在等。 tā réngrán zài děng: he's still waiting
cards.Notes: 仍 still + 然 so = still so. A written 还.

cards.Example: 屏幕上显示时间。 píngmù shang xiǎnshì shíjiān: the screen shows the time
cards.Notes: 显 visible + 示 show = display.

cards.Example: 他仍没回来。 tā réng méi huílai: he still hasn't come back
cards.Notes: 亻 person + 乃 nǎi (sound hint). Lookalike: 扔 rēng throw, with 扌 hand.

cards.Example: 这个相当难。 zhège xiāngdāng nán: this is pretty hard
cards.Notes: 相 mutual + 当 match, equal = mutually equal → equivalent; also "quite, considerably".

cards.Meaning: the other party, the other side
cards.Example: 对方不同意。 duìfāng bù tóngyì: the other side doesn't agree
cards.Notes: 对 opposite + 方 side = the opposite side.

cards.Example: 这是正式的会议。 zhè shì zhèngshì de huìyì: this is a formal meeting
cards.Notes: 正 proper, upright + 式 form = proper form → formal.

cards.Example: 他们感情很好。 tāmen gǎnqíng hěn hǎo: they're very close
cards.Notes: 感 feel (心 heart + 咸 xián for the sound) + 情 emotion = feelings.

cards.Example: 说说你的感受。 shuōshuo nǐ de gǎnshòu: tell me how you feel
cards.Notes: 感 feel + 受 receive = what you take in and feel → experience.

cards.Example: 他在我后面。 tā zài wǒ hòumian: he's behind me
cards.Notes: 后 back + 面 side = the back side.

cards.Example: 我来记录。 wǒ lái jìlù: I'll take notes
cards.Notes: 记 note down + 录 record = record. Also a sports record: 世界记录.

cards.Example: 他显然不高兴。 tā xiǎnrán bù gāoxìng: he's obviously unhappy
cards.Notes: 显 visible + 然 so = visibly so → obviously.

cards.Example: 外面很冷。 wàimiàn hěn lěng: it's cold outside
cards.Notes: 外 outside + 面 side = the outer side. Often said wàimian.
